Software for the world's container ports

Acme Freight builds the terminal operating system used by mid-sized container ports to plan vessel stowage, schedule cranes and bill their customers. We are paid by port operators on annual licences, and our software moves roughly 4 million containers a year.

We are a team of 60, headquartered in Rotterdam with engineers across Europe.
